title: Preview a calendar extension
eyebrow: No debit, grant or consent on preview
notice: An extension adds calendar days to this scope's deadline, or planned minutes or episodes to its work limit, paid from the allowances enabled here. The server rechecks the levels above, the allowance and the revisions.
days.hint: The API accepts 1–366 days; this scope’s per-grant allowance and ancestor caps may be stricter.
notExtendable: This scope is not currently extendable: it needs an active enrollment and an enabled allowance (calendar days also need a deadline or window here).
hypothetical: No allowance has been consumed. These balances are hypothetical after a future grant. Proposing requests the learner's consent; it cannot supply that consent.
impact.placeholder: Explain how the additional days affect the learner’s existing plan.
alternatives.placeholder: For example, continue with the current deadline.
reviewed: I reviewed these exact terms and want to propose them to the learner. This is not learner consent.
cannotPropose: Your role can inspect policy and preview terms but cannot propose offers.
minutes.hint: Raises this scope's planned-minutes limit; paid from a minutes allowance.
episodes.hint: Raises this scope's episode limit; paid from an episodes allowance.
